issues.detail: The Hebrew 'מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים' means 'from Ur of the Chaldeans' (a place name, Ur). The Chinese renders it as '從迦勒底人的火地' ('from the fire-land of the Chaldeans'), interpreting 'אוּר' (Ur) as the Hebrew word for 'fire' rather than as the city name. This changes the proper name/place name and the meaning of the verse.
